name: get_analysis_markdown
description: Return the cached markdown export of the full training program (current block). This is the primary reference document for coaching decisions. Use the cache unless it is stale, dirty, or refresh is true.

name: analysis_section
description: Compute a single deterministic weekly analysis section. Loads program+sessions via the ProgramStore layer, fetches glossary via direct DynamoDB, then computes one analysis section (e.g. "volume", "intensity", "progression"). AI section keys (ai_correlation, program_evaluation) are rejected before reaching this core.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

refresh.description: Force recompute instead of using cached value. Default false.

name: analyze_powerlifting_stats
description: Analyze powerlifting statistics for the current program version. Computes totals, Wilks, DOTS, and comparative metrics. Copied from tools/health/powerlifting_stats.py.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

name: analyze_progression
description: Analyze progression rate for the current program. Loads program+sessions, then calls analytics.progression_rate to compute week-over-week progression trends.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

name: analyze_rpe_drift
description: Analyze RPE (rate of perceived exertion) drift for a specific exercise over a window of weeks. Loads program+sessions, then calls analytics.rpe_drift. Uses window_weeks (default 4) to set the lookback period.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

name: block_correlation_analysis
description: Generate an AI correlation report for a specific block. Analyzes relationships between training variables (volume, intensity, RPE) and outcomes (progression, fatigue). Uses AI to generate natural-language findings and summary.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

name: block_program_evaluation
description: Generate an AI program evaluation report for a specific block. Assesses the overall program design, exercise selection, volume distribution, and progression. Uses AI to produce a structured evaluation with recommendations.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

name: correlation_analysis
description: Generate a correlation analysis report across training variables. Analyzes how volume, intensity, RPE, and other factors correlate with progression. Uses cached DynamoDB values for deterministic sections.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

weeks.description: Number of weeks to analyze. Default 4.

block.description: Block key to scope the analysis.

name: multi_block_comparison_analysis
description: Generate a comparison report across multiple training blocks. Analyzes differences in volume, intensity, progression, and outcomes between blocks. Uses AI to produce a structured comparison.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

block_keys.description: List of block keys to compare.

name: powerlifting_filter_categories
description: List available filter categories for powerlifting ranking data. Returns the distinct values for federation, equipment, gender, and weight class filters used by the ranking percentile tool.

name: powerlifting_ranking_percentile
description: Compute the ranking percentile for a given total, body weight, gender, equipment, and federation. Returns the percentile rank compared to known competition results.

name: program_evaluation
description: Generate an AI program evaluation report for the current program. Assesses overall design, volume, intensity, exercise selection, and progression. Caches results in DynamoDB for fast retrieval.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

name: regenerate_analysis
description: Regenerate deterministic current-block analysis caches and markdown export. AI reports are intentionally excluded — they are regenerated only through explicit AI section tools. NEVER touches past-block caches.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

block_key.description: Block key to regenerate analysis for.

name: weekly_analysis
description: Build a full sectioned deterministic weekly analysis for the current program. Loads program+sessions, fetches glossary, then computes all deterministic analysis sections via the analytics module. AI sections (program_evaluation, correlation) are intentionally omitted.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

name: health_suggest_e1rm_multipliers
description: Suggest per lift e1RM multipliers from completed competition results and max history compared with recent session estimates.

name: analytics.manifest
description: Return section statuses, windows, and the current analysis source fingerprint.

name: analytics.sections_queue
description: Queue requested analysis sections for the selected window.

name: analytics.sections_get
description: Return one analysis section status and payload for the selected window.

name: analytics.sections_invalidate
description: Invalidate and requeue requested analysis sections for the selected window.

name: analytics.weekly
description: Return the legacy weekly analysis report for the requested window.

name: analytics.bundle
description: Return the complete current block weekly analysis bundle.

name: analytics.blocks_list
description: List analyzed training blocks and their cache/data quality status.

name: analytics.blocks_get
description: Return the cached or regenerated analysis bundle for one block.

name: analytics.blocks_regenerate
description: Regenerate one block analysis and its associated reports.

name: analytics.block_evaluation
description: Return the cached AI evaluation for one block.

name: analytics.correlation
description: Return the cached AI correlation report for one block.

name: analytics.export
description: Return a block analysis export as base64 with its content metadata.

name: analytics.compare
description: Compare selected training blocks using deterministic analytics.

name: analytics.compare_ai
description: Compare selected training blocks with the cached AI synthesis.

name: analytics.regenerate
description: Regenerate selected analysis sections and windows.

name: analytics.markdown
description: Return the cached markdown export of the full training program.
